text.description_html:
First Impressions SD-DLG100012SMTSS4 Delong Shower Door Pull Set

The 12 Inch Stainless Steel Delong Shower Door Pull is a great addition to any glass door. It comes packaged with everything you'll need to install it back to back on 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch thick glass. The Delong Shower Door Pull Set is the epitome of contemporary door hardware. The grip is made out of stainless steel and the hourglass-shaped mounts are made out of brass, allowing the possibility to mix and match finishes. The Stainless Steel Delong Glass Door Pull is made in the USA by First Impressions--a leader in custom door hardware.

Also Available Matching 1 Inch Stainless Steel Delong Pull

Features and Specifications of the Stainless Steel Shower Door Pull:

  • Pull Handle Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Total Length: 12"
  • Center to Center: 8"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
  • Mounting Bracket Diameter: 7/8"
  • Total Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Pull Clearance: 1.66"
  • Door Mounting: 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.
  • Door pull includes installation hardware.
  • First Impressions DLG100012SMTSS4 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Note: This door pull is handmade assembled in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with 2 door pulls, 4 rosettes plus mounting hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.
